reasons.claim: Three taḥwīl branches open the chain, the third with two co-transmitters joined by «قالا».
reasons.quote: وحدثني زهير بن حرب، وابن المثنى، قالا حدثنا يحيى

reasons.claim: «كلهم عن» makes the rest a tail shared by every branch.
reasons.quote: كلهم عن عبيد الله، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر

reasons.claim: «أبي» in the second branch is Ibn Numayr's unnamed father, a relation link.
No transmitter is written; the Imam is the one asked and answering, so he is the single link (ruling 2).
reasons.quote: وَ فِي خَبَرٍ آخَرَ : سُئِلَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ

reviews.uncertainty_note: A report with no transmitter at all may be treated differently by the owner.

reasons.claim: A single chain ends at Aisha, whose own words follow; the stored chain wrongly stops at Urwa.
reasons.quote: عن عروة، أن عائشة، رضى الله عنها أخبرته

reasons.claim: «هو ابن سعيد» is a gloss on Ishaq, not a link; the chain ends at Ibn Umar, who speaks.
reasons.quote: حدثنا إسحاق  هو ابن سعيد  عن سعيد، عن ابن عمر

reasons.claim: Four co-transmitters meet at Sufyan through «قالوا».
reasons.quote: ومحمود بن غيلان، قالوا حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة

reasons.claim: Salim's unnamed father is the last link and speaks; those seen walking are not links.
reasons.quote: عن سالم، عن أبيه، قال رأيت النبي

reasons.claim: After Abu Ubayd the text writes only unnamed connected chains, an unnamed link.
reasons.quote: عن أبي عبيد القاسم بن سلام بأسانيد متصلة إلى النبي

reasons.claim: The stored chain takes words of the explanation as names.

reviews.uncertainty_note: The explanatory matter after the saying could be read as Abu Ubayd's comment; it adds no link either way.

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters meet at Zuhayr with «جميعا»; the dashed remark only states Ibn Yunus's wording and adds no route.
reasons.quote: جميعا عن زهير، - قال ابن يونس حدثنا زهير، -

reasons.claim: Abu al-Zubayr's later question runs along the same route and adds no link.
One chain ends at Ibn Mughaffal, who speaks; «شك كهمس» is a note on the wording.
reasons.quote: عن عبد الله بن مغفل، أنه رأى رجلا يخذف فقال

reasons.claim: The father and «جماعة مشايخي» are co-transmitters at the first level.
Abu Abdillah narrates an event in which Amir al-Mu'minin speaks; under ruling 9 the speaker is the last link, which both readers omit.
The relayed words are Amir al-Mu'minin's.

levels.surface: جعفر بن محمد بن عبيد الله

notes: Amir al-Mu'minin speaks inside the Imam's narrated story: last link (ruling 9).

reviews.uncertainty_note: Ruling 9's example has the narrator present; here Abu Abdillah does not say he was present, so a second reading stopping at him is possible.

reasons.claim: One chain read to Malik ends at Ibn Umar; «واللفظ له» is a note, and the stored chain stops too early.
reasons.quote: قال قرأت على مالك عن نافع عن ابن عمر
